release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD966A-1100ZK2FD is a bi-spectrum cooled thermal sphere PTZ pairing a 640x512 MCT cooled MWIR thermal imager (110 to 1100 mm) with a 2 MP 100x low-lux optical camera and an integrated 1570 nm eye-safe laser range finder (100 m to 10 km), for extreme long-range border and coastal surveillance with vessel detection, GPS positioning and perimeter VCA. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and optical exposed as separate channels; thermal is usually Channel 2, optical Channel 1.
